name: Primary Obligation
description: Baseline mandatory performance that satisfies the primary contract duty.

ast_component.name: ${concise action verb phrase, e.g. Deliver ATP-passing engine components}
ast_component.initiatorName: ${party legally obligated to perform, e.g. XYZ Parts}
ast_component.recipientName: ${counterparty receiving performance or deliverable, e.g. Automobiles-X}
ast_component.annotation: ${specific timeframe or operational trigger, e.g. Primary order placed; deliver on schedule}
ast_component.fallbackQuestion: ${evaluative yes/no question whether primary duty was performed on schedule, e.g. Did components pass ATP and get delivered on time?}
ast_component.fallbackStepId: ${ID of the intermediate remedy or cure step if this fails, or 'end-breach' if no cure exists}
nextStepIds: ${ID of the subsequent happy path step, or 'end-fulfill' if this satisfies the contract}

name: Contrary-to-Duty (Failing Which / Remedy)
description: Secondary cure, replacement, or repair triggered when a prior obligation fails.
text_clues: must provide a functional replacement within
failure to remedy on-site results in

ast_component.name: ${concise remedy or replacement action, e.g. Deliver identical replacement component within 12 hours}
ast_component.initiatorName: ${party performing the cure or replacement, e.g. XYZ Parts}
ast_component.recipientName: ${party receiving the remedy or replacement, e.g. Automobiles-X}
ast_component.annotation: ${breach condition activating this cure, e.g. Triggered when primary component fails ATP}
ast_component.fallbackQuestion: ${evaluative yes/no question whether this remedy was completed within the cure deadline, e.g. Was identical replacement delivered within 12 hours?}
ast_component.fallbackStepId: ${ID of the next escalation remedy if this cure fails, or 'end-breach' if terminal}
nextStepIds: ${ID of next step on successful cure, or 'end-fulfill' if cure satisfies the contract}

name: The Last Chance to Compensate
description: Final monetary settlement, maximum refund, or liquidated damages right before total uncompensated breach.
text_clues: failing which results in full refund plus liquidated damages
as a last resort prior to contract breach

ast_component.name: ${terminal compensation or refund action, e.g. Issue 100% refund plus $500 liquidated damages}
ast_component.initiatorName: ${party paying the final compensation or refund, e.g. Vendor-C}
ast_component.recipientName: ${party receiving final payout, or deducting payment, e.g. Couple}
ast_component.annotation: ${exhaustion condition triggering this final remedy, e.g. Prior remedy failed; final cure window of 5 business days}
ast_component.fallbackQuestion: ${evaluative yes/no question whether final compensation was tendered, e.g. Was 100% refund and liquidated damages paid within 5 days?}

name: Permission (Optional Discretionary Right)
description: Optional privilege or right exercisable at a party's sole election; declining it preserves contract fulfillment without breach.

ast_component.name: ${optional or discretionary action, e.g. Request complimentary spa access}
ast_component.initiatorName: ${party entitled to exercise the option, e.g. Guest}
ast_component.recipientName: ${party responding to the option, e.g. Hotel}
ast_component.annotation: ${window or terms governing this discretionary option, e.g. Discretionary option exercisable upon check-in}
ast_component.fallbackQuestion: ${evaluative yes/no question whether the party elects to exercise this right, e.g. Does Guest elect to exercise complimentary spa access?}
ast_component.fallbackStepId: ${ID of standard workflow continuation step when option is bypassed without penalty}
nextStepIds: ${ID of subsequent step when option is exercised}

name: Forbidden (Negative Covenant / Prohibited Act)
description: Express prohibition against an action. Non-occurrence maintains fulfillment; occurrence triggers violation cure.

ast_component.name: ${negative covenant obligation, e.g. Refrain from unauthorized subcontracting}
ast_component.initiatorName: ${party restricted by the covenant, e.g. Contractor}
ast_component.recipientName: ${party protected by the covenant, e.g. Client}
ast_component.annotation: ${scope of prohibition, e.g. Negative covenant effective throughout contract term}
ast_component.fallbackQuestion: ${evaluative yes/no question whether covenant is observed without breach, e.g. Is negative covenant observed without unauthorized subcontracting?}
ast_component.fallbackStepId: ${ID of penalty or cure step if prohibition is violated, e.g. step-pay-unauthorized-subcontracting-penalty}
nextStepIds: ${ID of next step on continued covenant compliance, or 'end-fulfill'}

name: Trigger Condition (Premise / Milestone Event)
description: Contractual condition precedent, temporal milestone, or failure detection that initiates a service flow.

ast_component.name: ${concise label of triggering condition or milestone, e.g. Prior to wedding event}
ast_component.annotation: ${full temporal or operational premise description, e.g. Timeline milestone: Setup window opens 3 hours prior to ceremony}
nextStepIds: ${ID of the first primary obligation task activated by this trigger}
